faq.q: Is Spires of Azeroth free to play?
faq.a: The author describes it as a free browser game with free desktop and Android versions. Solo play needed no game account when we checked on 4 November 2026.

faq.q: Is it the same game as Azeroth Survivors?
faq.a: No. Spires of Azeroth is turn-based card combat on a climbing map; Azeroth Survivors is a separate automatic-spell survival game by another author. Saves and builds do not carry over.

faq.q: Can I play Spires of Azeroth on my phone?
faq.a: The game window loads in a mobile browser, and the original menu gives a Safari Add to Home Screen route for iPhone and iPad. We tested browser sizes only, not a physical phone, so a landscape view or a larger screen is safer for reading small cards.

faq.q: Does Spires of Azeroth have co-op?
faq.a: The original title menu shows a Co-op button (seen 21 November 2026). No co-op session has been run for this guide, so it does not describe how co-op works.

faq.q: Will my saved run move between the browser and the app?
faq.a: Not automatically. The author says desktop saves are separate from the browser, and a framed game and a separate tab can store progress differently. Back up first and keep the same host and browser profile.

faq.q: What should I pick first as a new player?
faq.a: Any class can start a first run. The guide gives class identity cues, not a power ranking: choose the card style you enjoy and read the starter deck in the game before you commit.

faq.q: The game window is blank. What do I do?
faq.a: Wait for resources to finish loading, then open the original in its own tab. Note the host and build shown, and do not clear site data first because it can remove progress.
